title: PresentationModel
description: Redacted, renderer-only view of findings/trace (ADR-0016 §3): what templates/explain/report.md consume. Mirrors DecisionRecord's findings exactly (same finding shape, reused by $ref) — no raw fact value (the finding shape has no such field). Rendered markdown is not a declared property (ADR-0016 §4); top-level additionalProperties are allowed for forward/additive tolerance (ADR-0017 §9) — renderers must ignore unknown fields rather than treat them as contract.

findings.description: Named collection keyed by (rule, subject) — mandatory unique ID composite; source order carries no meaning without an explicit priority (ADR-0017 §9).
